rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_cmi_dead (
	id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
	hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
	areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
	flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
	date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
	b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	monthly varchar(7) NOT NULL,
	region varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	chwcode varchar(2) NOT NULL,
	splevel varchar(2) NOT NULL,
	cases int(5) DEFAULT 0,
	adjrw double(10,4) DEFAULT 0,
	adjrw0 int(5) DEFAULT 0,
	referin int(5) DEFAULT 0,
	referin_adjrw0 int(5) DEFAULT 0,
	referin_adjrw double(10,4) DEFAULT 0,
	los int(8) DEFAULT 0,
	price double(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
	price0 int(5) DEFAULT 0,
	lastupdate TIMESTAMP,
	PRIMARY KEY (monthly,hospcode),
	KEY (id),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_cmi_dead WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_cmi_dead
(
SELECT
@id,p.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
,@b_year+543 as b_year, p.monthly, p.region, p.chwcode, p.splevel
,SUM(cases) as cases
,SUM(sum_adjrw) as adjrw
,SUM(p.adjrw0) as adjrw0
,SUM(p.referin) as referin
,SUM(p.referin_adjrw0) as referin_adjrw0
,SUM(p.referin_adjrw) as referin_adjrw
,SUM(p.los) as los
,SUM(p.price) as price
,SUM(p.price0) as price0
,now() as lastupdate
FROM t_cmi_dead p INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE p.chwcode=@prov_c
GROUP BY p.hospcode,p.monthly
);

sum(cases) as cases , sum(adjrw) as adjrw , sum(adjrw0) as adjrw0 ,sum(adjrw)/(sum(cases)-sum(adjrw0)) as cmi , sum(referin) as referin , sum(referin_adjrw) as referin_adjrw , sum(referin_adjrw0) as referin_adjrw0 , sum(referin_adjrw)/(sum(referin)-sum(referin_adjrw0)) as referin_cmi , sum(los) as los , sum(los)/sum(cases) as avg_los , sum(price) as price , sum(price0) as price0 , sum(price)/(sum(cases)-sum(price0)) as avg_price  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT changwatcode as ar_code ,changwatname as ar_name,changwatcode as l_code FROM cchangwat WHERE (zonecode={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) GROUP BY l_code ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left(s.areacode,2)=ar.l_code     INNER JOIN ( SELECT hoscode as hcode,chospital_regis.* FROM chospital_regis INNER JOIN cchangwat ON chospital_regis.provcode=cchangwat.changwatcode WHERE chospital_regis.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND chospital_regis.hdc_regist=1 AND chospital_regis.status ='1' AND (zonecode={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) GROUP BY hoscode ) h ON s.hospcode=h.hcode     LEFT JOIN ccmihosp sp ON sp.hcode=h.hoscode AND sp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1))     AND (h.provcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}}='ALL')    AND provider.query: SELECT concat(ar_code,' ',ar_name) as areamame ,count(*) as nomonth ,sum(cases) as target1 , sum(adjrw) as result1 , ROUND((sum(adjrw)/(sum(cases)-sum(adjrw0))),4) as p , sum(cases) as cases , sum(adjrw) as adjrw , sum(adjrw0) as adjrw0 ,sum(adjrw)/(sum(cases)-sum(adjrw0)) as cmi , sum(referin) as referin , sum(referin_adjrw) as referin_adjrw , sum(referin_adjrw0) as referin_adjrw0 , sum(referin_adjrw)/(sum(referin)-sum(referin_adjrw0)) as referin_cmi , sum(los) as los , sum(los)/sum(cases) as avg_los , sum(price) as price , sum(price0) as price0 , sum(price)/(sum(cases)-sum(price0)) as avg_price  FROM  {{S_TABLE}} as s     INNER JOIN ( SELECT hoscode as ar_code,hosname as ar_name,chospital.*,hcode as hospcode,hcode,splevel FROM ccmihosp INNER JOIN chospital  ON ccmihosp.hcode=chospital.hoscode WHERE byear =SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}},',',-1) AND (splevel={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (ccmihosp.region={{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (ccmihosp.chwcode={{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{PROVINCE_CODE}}) GROUP BY hcode ) h ON s.hospcode=h.hospcode  WHERE s.id={{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode,2) not IN('99') AND b_year IN(SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)) AND h.hdc_regist=1     AND (s.hospcode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or 'ALL'={{HOSPITAL_CODE}})     AND (h.amp_code={{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.tmb_code={{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}='ALL')      AND (h.dep in ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}='ALL')    AND (h.dep={{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.mcode={{MINISTRY_CODE}} or {{MINISTRY_CODE}}='ALL')    AND (h.hoscode={{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}}='ALL') GROUP BY ar_code
